requirement:
HC's validation policy requires each issue linked by a FIXME to remain open.
A deterministic criterion reads the issue through the SDK's tracked inspection
interface and assesses its supplied status. `Closed` produces a completed
failing assessment; `Open` satisfies this status check. The check does not
require a configured agent.
rationale: Add tests marked {test}`requirements.sdk.habeas.github_nodes.open`. They should drive the deterministic open-issue criterion through the SDK's tracked issue inspection interface with a fake issue source and no configured agent. One test should supply a `Closed` issue and assert a completed failing assessment. Another should supply an `Open` issue and assert that the status check is satisfied. Also assert that no agent or model call is made. Then either implement the criterion or replace the stale {fixme} with an accurate one. — The requirement has no {test} references, and I found no test of the criterion in `src/`. Its obligations are untested: a `Closed` issue must produce a completed failing assessment, an `Open` issue must satisfy the check, and the check must not need an agent. The only acknowledgment is the `{fixme}` on `src/sdk.rs#enum[HabeasNode]`, which names nikomatsakis/habeas-codicem#26. That issue is closed, so the acknowledgment does not cover the gap.
